ground_truth: The change makes `is_valid_ipv6_address()` call the new helper `_ipv6_address_from_str()` instead of `ipaddress.IPv6Address(ip_str)`. The helper begins with `if len(ip_str) > max_length`, and `is_valid_ipv6_address()` still only catches `ValueError`. Before, non-string values that `ipaddress.IPv6Address` accepts, such as an `ipaddress.IPv6Address` instance or an int, were handled. Now they raise an uncaught `TypeError` (e.g. "object of type 'IPv6Address' has no len()"). As a result, `validate_ipv6_address(ipaddress.IPv6Address('::1'))` and `validate_ipv46_address(...)` crash instead of validating or raising `ValidationError`. The fix returns True early for `ipaddress.IPv6Address` instances and catches `TypeError` as well as `ValueError`, returning False.
